next_design_requirements: Compare regional production retained after a shared command schedule, not independent rewards for touching each city. A mobile field column may cover several cities only when it can actually respond in time.
Plan neutral purchases together with occupation and reinforcement. Account for the purchase cost separately from symmetric combat and temporary denial value.
Give reconnaissance an explicit destination into unresolved enemy territory, a force budget, and a continuation/return condition; do not equate short recapture routes with discovery.
Compare fresh opponent advance, production raids, and waiting/collection responses against the same candidate sequence. Home survival alone does not certify economic safety.
Evaluate changes with executed Arena and online matches; frozen human histories are diagnostic evidence only.
decision: No strategy promoted and no formal evaluation started. Working source unchanged. Initial unfinished tempo source preserved separately; human regional-control review takes priority over another narrow home-response adjustment.
